19|        case YAML_STREAM_START_EVENT:

39|                    event_from->data.alias.anchor);
40|
41|        case YAML_SCALAR_EVENT:
42|            return yaml_scalar_event_initialize(event_to,

57|
58|        case YAML_SEQUENCE_END_EVENT:
